text:
anna_docs: Heads-up: opened PR for release notes + changelog updates for the model catalog changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 Needs reviews for deprecation wording and migration note. cc @sahil @maria_pm

sahil: On it. Will review deprecations and migration steps today. Any constraints on merge timing? Want to coordinate with Dedicated rollout.

maria_pm: We should hold merge until after the canary tomorrow morning, otherwise customers might see deprecation notice before rollout. Can we gate with a tag?

anna_docs: Thanks — I added a `do-not-merge` label and put a short canary checklist in the PR description. Also added a draft release note blurb under "Unreleased" in CHANGELOG.

tim_engineering: :eyes: Quick note — CI preview failed on this PR, docs site build error: missing frontmatter in docs/model-catalog/compat.md. Log: ```ERROR: Frontmatter missing: docs/model-catalog/compat.md at line 1```

anna_docs: Ack. Fixing now — I accidentally removed the yaml header when copying migration snippet. Pushing a fix in a sec.

ci-bot: Netlify Preview (pull/512): build failed after 3m 12s — https://deploy.netlify.com/builds/abc123/log

anna_docs: Pushed fix and force-pushed update. Also reworded migration steps to be clearer about quantization changes and mapping old keys to new: `gpt2->gpt2-compat`.

sahil: Quick suggestion on migration note: can we add a sample curl + SDK snippet for pinning to old model alias? e.g., `client.generate({ model: 'gpt2-legacy', ... })`

anna_docs: Added SDK snippet (JS + Python) and example output. Also added a short 'what to expect' section about performance/latency after migration.

olivia_release: From release side: when this merges, I'll update release notes with the blurb and schedule the public changelog announcement for next Wed. Please confirm merge window is after canary (tomorrow 10:00 PT).

maria_pm: Confirming — don't merge until 10:30 PT tomorrow so we can verify telemetry.

sahil: LGTM for deprecation wording. One nit: change 'deprecated' -> 'deprecated (effective date: 2026-04-01)'.

anna_docs: Updated phrasing and date. CI preview now passed: Netlify Preview (pull/512): success — https://deploy.netlify.com/builds/abc123/success

ci-bot: Docs patch lint: 0 warnings, 0 errors.

olivia_release: :shipit: I'll merge at 10:45 PT after canary checks unless anyone objects.

tim_engineering: No objections from infra. Please also add a rollback note in the changelog with command to revert alias: `redwood model alias set gpt2-legacy gpt2@v1`

anna_docs: Added rollback line and final changelog entry. Thanks everyone — merging at 10:45 PT. Will paste final PR/commit when done.

anna_docs: Merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512/commits/9f3a2. Release notes section updated under /CHANGELOG.md. :tada:

olivia_release: Copied changelog into release draft. Tagging customers list and internal release notes. Great job.
